reverse_inplace.name: reverse_inplace
reverse_inplace.code:
```python
def reverse_list(arr):
    left, right = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while left < right:
        arr[left], arr[right] = arr[right], arr[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return arr
```

linked_list_reverse.code:
```python
def reverse_list(head):
    prev, cur = None, head
    while cur:
        nxt = cur.next
        cur.next = prev
        prev = cur
        cur = nxt
    return prev
```
